subject: log or log10 transform predictor variable?

messages.author: 4c16debd333db67f
messages.subject: log or log10 transform predictor variable?
parts:
Hello,

I'm using gmultmix() to fit models to waterbird count data, which is mostly explained by wetland size ("area"). Models with log(area,10) are more highly supported than those with untransformed area, but a colleague recently suggested that model outputs would be easier to interpret if I used the natural log of wetland area i.e. log(area) because gmultmix() uses a ln-link. I'm open to this change but would like to learn more before implementing it, so am appealing to the group for any advice. Thanks in advance!

Mark
